decision: Add a fail-closed standalone operator path for onboarding, diagnostics, macOS LaunchAgent lifecycle, persistent credentials, and stopped-service state backup and restore without advancing product maturity.
implemented_capabilities: secret-free onboarding with separate configuration and state roots
idempotent operator initialization plus status and bounded doctor diagnostics
per-user macOS arm64 LaunchAgent install, start, stop, restart, status, and uninstall
managed private file credentials for persistent services and interactive environment references
crash-recoverable runtime and maintenance exclusion locks outside state_dir
checksummed state snapshots, SQLite online backup validation, pre-restore safety backup, and stopped-service restore
architectural_invariants: state_dir remains the single runtime state authority and configuration stays outside it
the service plist and operator output never contain credential values
backup and restore refuse to run while the LaunchAgent is loaded or a conflicting lifecycle lease exists
backups live outside state_dir and may contain credentials, which is surfaced without revealing them
CI and local implementation evidence do not advance maturity or release authority
managed code-version rollback remains pending until launchd executes a verified release pointer bound to matching state
